anomalies.title: Profit is positive while operating cash flow is negative
anomalies.detail: Net profit of 5,180 thousand MYR was reported for FY2025 while net cash from operating activities was −2,310 thousand MYR, a swing of 10,215 thousand MYR from FY2024.
anomalies.follow_up: Ask which working-capital movements or non-cash items explain the gap between reported profit and cash generated.

anomalies.title: Revenue increased while net profit fell
anomalies.detail: Revenue rose 11.89% to 148,200 thousand MYR while net profit fell 37.14% to 5,180 thousand MYR. Gross margin narrowed from 23.0% to 21.0%.
anomalies.follow_up: Request a cost breakdown to identify whether input costs, pricing, or one-off charges drove the margin compression.

anomalies.title: Current liabilities exceed current assets
anomalies.detail: Current ratio moved from 1.18x to 0.93x as current liabilities reached 66,950 thousand MYR against current assets of 62,400 thousand MYR.
anomalies.follow_up: Confirm the maturity profile of current liabilities and any undrawn facilities available within twelve months.

anomalies.title: Borrowings rose materially between periods
anomalies.detail: Borrowings increased 43.12% from 38,150 to 54,600 thousand MYR, lifting debt-to-equity from 0.81x to 1.13x.
anomalies.follow_up: Ask what the additional borrowings funded and whether covenants are tied to the debt-to-equity level.

anomalies.title: Receivables grew faster than revenue
anomalies.detail: Trade receivables grew 41.55% against revenue growth of 11.89%. The receivables figure is also inconsistent between the two uploaded sources.
anomalies.follow_up: Request an ageing analysis and confirm which receivables figure is authoritative before relying on this comparison.

anomalies.title: Trade receivables conflict across two documents
anomalies.detail: The annual report states 41,900 thousand MYR while the trial balance states 40,150 thousand MYR. Both values are retained; neither was overwritten.
anomalies.follow_up: Confirm with the preparer which source reflects the final audited position.

anomalies.title: Trade payables could not be read reliably
anomalies.detail: The trade payables table is a scanned region and returned low confidence. No value was substituted and payables-based ratios were not calculated.
anomalies.follow_up: Re-upload a searchable copy of note 21 or enter the payables balance manually in a future reviewed workflow.

insights.title: Growth is being funded by debt rather than operations
insights.narrative: Revenue grew for a fifth consecutive period, but operating cash flow turned negative while borrowings and receivables rose. On the extracted figures, FY2025 expansion was financed externally rather than self-funded.

insights.title: Margin compression is the main driver of the profit fall
insights.narrative: Gross margin narrowed by two percentage points and operating margin by roughly two and a half, so profit fell despite higher sales. Because profit before tax is not disclosed separately, the split between operating and financing effects cannot be confirmed from this report alone.

insights.title: Equity base held up and revenue momentum continued
insights.narrative: Shareholders' equity increased year on year and the five-period revenue trend remains upward. Return on equity remains positive at 10.74%, though it is down from 17.58%.

follow_up_questions: Which working-capital movements explain the negative operating cash flow in FY2025?
What did the additional 16,450 thousand MYR of borrowings fund?
Are any current liabilities expected to be refinanced within twelve months?
Which trade receivables figure is authoritative — the annual report or the trial balance?
Can a searchable copy of note 21 be supplied so trade payables can be extracted?
